notablePrerequisites: You control an additional modified creature.
description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other modified creature you control with power one or greater.
The creature dies, triggering One with the Kami, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Each Spirit enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
